POST /api/academy/lesson-complete - returns xp object with base_xp, bonus_xp, total_xp_earned, streak_increased, current_streak
Lesson XP: 20 base XP for new lesson, 0 for duplicate (farming prevention)
Quiz XP: 60 for perfect (100%), 40 for pass (60-99%), 0 for fail (<60%)
Streak increment on first activity of day, no increment on subsequent activities same day
Daily streak bonus: +10 XP added to total_xp_earned
Leaderboard XP updated after lesson-complete and quiz-submit
